mentions.name: Hymn presentation website
mentions.description: A website that displays hymn lyrics on the TVs at the front of a church so the congregation can follow along during services. It is designed for the builder's father, an organist who changes lyric pages with a foot pedal while playing and singing. The interface includes only the buttons he needs and only his own hymns, and it is maintained directly by the builder so it can be tailored to him.
mentions.problem: The organist's current hymn presentation software is too complicated, with too many buttons and features, and he gets lost using it.
mentions.audience: The builder's father, a church organist
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm making a hymn presentation website for my dad. He's an organist at the local church and they've got TV's at the front showing everyone the words to the hymns. He switches the pages using a foot pedal while he plays and sings.
